_meta.description: Locally ADOPTED code editions by jurisdiction. A permit is reviewed against these, not the latest published editions. 'verify' notes mark values that could not be confirmed from a primary source. Re-check before each project: states re-adopt on ~3-year cycles.

DEFAULT.name: No jurisdiction set — latest published editions (reference only)
notes: Set a jurisdiction to get the edition a permit is actually reviewed against.

UT.name: Utah (statewide; Salt Lake City follows state adoption)
notes: NFPA 13/13R/13D/20 = 2019, NFPA 24 = 2019, NFPA 25 = 2020, NFPA 72 = 2019 per State Fire Marshal code list.
IBC listed as 2018 by the State Fire Marshal; some secondary sources cite 2021 — confirm on design documents per Utah Code 15A-2-103. Either way ASCE 7-16 governs seismic.
SLC applies codes in effect on the date the plan submission is accepted (SLC Code 18.20.050).

CA.name: California (2025 Title 24 — CBC/CFC)
notes: 2025 California Fire Code (Title 24 Part 9) is based on the 2024 IFC, effective Jan 1, 2026.
NFPA 13 edition: 2022 per the CFC referenced-standards table (California amended) — VERIFY against CFC Chapter 80 and local ordinance; California historically lags NFPA editions.
Projects permitted under the prior 2022 CFC (2021 IFC basis) remain on that edition.

WA.name: Washington (State Building Code Council)
notes: NFPA 13 edition inferred as 2019 from the 2021 IFC referenced standards — VERIFY against WAC 51-54A amendments.
2024 I-Code adoption was estimated for Nov 1, 2026 — check current SBCC status before relying on 2021 editions.
